maddeler.e:
استفرغوا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْرَغُوا (istafraḡū) /is.taf.ra.ɣuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
# اُسْتُفْرِغُوا (ustufriḡū) /us.tuf.ri.ɣuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
# اِسْتَفْرِغُوا (istafriḡū) /is.taf.ri.ɣuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
